name: Reticlo Crosshair Library
author: leonblake786

sections.description:
Velocrosshairs helps gamers discover, organize and share a searchable collection of crosshair codes on their WordPress website. Add each crosshair as a separate entry with its import code, creator, game name and visual settings. With
velocrosshairs, visitors can easily search available designs, preview crosshair styles and copy codes with a single click to customize their gaming experience.

Features

  • Dedicated “Crosshairs” content type with its own “Collections” taxonomy (for example Pro, Minimal, Beginner).
  • Live CSS preview generated from color, length, gap, thickness and style values.
  • One-click copy button with accessible status feedback.
  • Instant client-side search by name, creator or game.
  • Responsive grid with 1 to 4 columns.
  • Single crosshair pages automatically show the card above the content.
  • Two simple shortcodes, no page builder required.
  • Lightweight: scripts and styles load only on pages that display a card.
  • No tracking, no external requests, no ads and no upsells.

Shortcodes

Show the full library:

[reticlo_library]

Show a filtered, sorted library:

[reticlo_library collection="pro" limit="9" columns="3" search="yes" orderby="title" order="ASC"]

Show one crosshair:

[reticlo_crosshair id="123"]

Shortcode attributes for [reticlo_library]

  • collection – one or more collection slugs, separated by commas.
  • limit – number of cards, 1 to 60 (default 12).
  • columns – 1 to 4 (default comes from the settings page).
  • search – yes or no (default yes).
  • orderby – date, title, modified or rand.
  • order – ASC or DESC.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect, store or transmit any visitor data and does not connect to any external service.

Trademarks

All game names and trademarks mentioned by site owners in their own content belong to their respective owners. This plugin is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any game publisher.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the reticlo-crosshair-library folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to “Crosshairs” > “Add New” and fill in the crosshair details.
  4. Add [reticlo_library] to any page or post.
  5. Optional: adjust defaults under Settings > Reticlo.
sections.faq:
Does the preview exactly match the in-game crosshair?

No. The preview is an approximate visual guide generated from the values you enter. The code you provide is what visitors copy and import.

Can I show only some crosshairs?

Yes. Assign crosshairs to collections and use the collection attribute, for example [reticlo_library collection="pro"].

Does it work with page builders and block themes?

Yes. Use the Shortcode block (or any shortcode widget) and paste one of the shortcodes.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

Only the plugin settings are removed. Your crosshair entries and collections stay in your database so you never lose content.

Does the plugin load anything from external servers?

No. All code, styles and scripts are bundled in the plugin.
